scripts.build: pnpm --filter @computebuilder/core build && pnpm --filter @computebuilder/svelte-ui build && pnpm --filter @computebuilder/web build
scripts.build:all: pnpm --filter @computebuilder/core build && pnpm --filter @computebuilder/svelte-ui build && pnpm --filter @computebuilder/web build
scripts.clean:all: pnpm clean && pnpm install && pnpm build
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); ['pnpm-lock.yaml', 'node_modules'].forEach(f => { const p = path.join(process.cwd(), f); if (fs.existsSync(p)) { fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }); console.log('Deleted ' + f); } }); const packages = fs.readdirSync(path.join(process.cwd(), 'packages')); const examples = fs.readdirSync(path.join(process.cwd(), 'examples')); [...packages, ...examples].forEach(pkg => { const nm = path.join(process.cwd(), 'packages', pkg, 'node_modules'); const sk = path.join(process.cwd(), 'packages', pkg, '.svelte-kit'); const nm2 = path.join(process.cwd(), 'examples', pkg, 'node_modules'); const sk2 = path.join(process.cwd(), 'examples', pkg, '.svelte-kit'); [nm, sk, nm2, sk2].forEach(p => { if (fs.existsSync(p)) { fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }); console.log('Deleted ' + p); } }); }); "
